interpretation.zero_measured: No attempt has run; zero is completion, not zero-percent accuracy. Pass/fail are null until measured.
interpretation.repairs: R1/R2 require actual preceding program/error. Provider retry is not an extra program repair.
interpretation.deep_dive: Document revision and fresh audience tests have separate identities and outputs; they do not overwrite Original results.
interpretation.condition_fairness: Same frozen targets and shared qualified declaration/runtime context. Report all targets and original-document evidence strata separately.

unscheduled_studies.question: Sequential all-entry README versus selected-API regeneration/order
unscheduled_studies.design_boundary: Match author token/call budgets and freeze entry selection/order before comparison. This is separate from the current initial README job.

unscheduled_studies.question: Attached-library refactoring/reorganization versus unchanged source
unscheduled_studies.design_boundary: Separate code-change arm with new source/treatment identities and behavior checks; removing duplicate benchmark targets is not library refactoring.

unscheduled_studies.question: Memory on versus off
unscheduled_studies.design_boundary: Freeze development-only memory before evaluation and hold its exposure constant. Do not import held-out task answers or prior evaluation failure logs.

unscheduled_studies.question: Matched puzzle evaluation
unscheduled_studies.design_boundary: Review and freeze task inputs, oracle boundary, treatment mapping, seeds and repair budget before scheduling.
